_comment: Kevala Home — WB True Cost Calculator · Update this file on GitHub to refresh all rates in the app · Last updated: May 2026

stamp_duty._note: Rates post July 1 2024 — pandemic rebate removed

gst._note: GST only on under-construction. Applied to agreement value.

mutation._note: KMC: per sq ft for sale deed. NKDA: ₹80/sqft first transfer; 0.5% resale. Rural: nominal BLRO fee.

legal._note: Estimated advocate fee. No statutory rate — market practice.

brokerage._note: Buyer pays 1% for resale/secondary. Nil for new builder projects.

incidentals._note: Deed writer (Mohurer), scanning, misc office costs

interior._note: Rough estimate for basic interior fit-out

society._note: Approximate society deposit: maintenance + club + parking

tds._note: Buyer deducts TDS from seller. Not buyer's cost but buyer's compliance duty.

ui.disclaimer: Stamp duty calculated on higher of agreement value or circle rate. Women buyers receive 1% stamp duty rebate. The 2% pandemic rebate ended July 1, 2024. GST applies only to under-construction properties without OC. Affordable housing: value ≤ ₹45L and carpet area ≤ 60 sqm in Kolkata. Registration at 1.1% effective rate. KMC mutation ~₹20/sq ft. Legal fees at 1% (market estimate). Brokerage standard 1% from buyer for resale; nil for new builder. TDS at 1% for properties above ₹50L — deposit via Form 26QB. All figures are estimates. Verify with your Sub-Registrar and legal advisor.
ui.data_source: WB Registration Dept, GST Council, WB Urban Development
